subject: wolf
prompt:
Image 1 is a style reference only: match its painting style, brushwork, lighting, rim light, framing, background and proportions. The person, the face, the headgear and every ornament must be different from Image 1 and must follow the description below exactly; do not copy the man, the helm, the horns or the trim from Image 1.

Head-and-shoulders portrait bust of one grey wolf of the deep wood, a summoned wolf (a beast, not a person), three-quarter view, the face turned toward the right side of the image. Square image. Framing: the top of the head or the ears about 9% from the top edge, the eyes about 39% from the top, the jaw about 62% from the top, the image cut at the chest, with dark empty space above and around the head. One creature only, no people, no riders. No claws, limbs or hands in view, no text, no border, no frame, no signature, no logo.
Lighting: a single warm candle key light from the upper left, a dim warm fill, deep warm shadows, and a thin soft warm rim light along the back of the head, the ears and the shoulders that separates the whole silhouette clearly from the background. Background: plain, unpatterned, very dark warm brown close to #1C1A17, with no objects.
Medium: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible brushwork, moderate detail, a strong readable silhouette: the shape of the head and ears and the lit face against the dark background must still read when the image is shrunk to 48 pixels.
Colors: muted and earthy. Nothing in the image glows; the eyes are amber and do not shine or glow. No saturated red, orange, green or blue area larger than a thin crack or a small patch.

Subject: A Wolf, a grey wolf of the deep wood, summoned by Thornwood druids and the gods of the hunt: wild, with no harness or collar.
Creature: a lean grey timber wolf in its prime, the head turned three-quarters toward the right, ears up and forward, a long muzzle, amber eyes, a watchful look, mouth closed; thick grey fur with darker grey along the brow and the top of the neck, a pale grey-cream muzzle and throat, a heavy ruff of fur at the neck. Marks: a dark saddle of fur on the nape, a pale blaze on the throat, a notch torn from the far ear.

identityMarks.mark: dark saddle of fur on the nape

review.note: Lean grey timber wolf with amber eyes, in the leaders' hand; the notched ear did not come out.
